items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Well, one time I heard him in a speakeasy... I heard about two, three numbers that he played. He was a nice piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was small when I heard Jelly Roll. He was very, very small.
There's a white pianist used to be around here, Kid Ross. Did you ever hear him? Worked in the houses on Basin Street too, like Lula White's.

Well, one time I heard him in a speakeasy. It was on Domaine and Robinson. He came down to Buck Willie. Little Willie. Because all the piano players from all parts of town would look Willie up when they thought that he was strong enough, you see. And they tell me him and Willie tied up there for a while, now came in on the last of it. I heard about two, three numbers that he played. He was a nice piano player. Who won? Well, everybody was playing for Willie. Willie had the reputation at that time. I think that…
